privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Ntizo connects customers with service providers. Doing that needs some of your data. This document says which, why, who it is shared with, and how to have it deleted. It is written to be read, not to be difficult.

sections.heading: What we collect
body: When you create an account: first and last name, email address, phone number, and a password, which we store hashed and never in readable form. If you sign in with Google, Google gives us your name, email and profile picture — never your password.
On your profile, if you fill them in: photo, a description of yourself, date of birth, gender, language and time zone.
Addresses you save for receiving services, including city, district, access directions, and the coordinates of the point you place on the map.
Payment methods: we store the mobile account identifier (an M-Pesa or e-Mola number, for example) and the country. We do not store card numbers.
If you are a provider: identity documents you upload for verification, and the status of that verification.
Technical data for each session: IP address and browser identification, so we can tell when a session is yours and when it is not.
What you write to us through the contact and feedback forms, with the IP address it was sent from, so we can reply and stop abuse.

sections.heading: What we use it for
body: To create and keep your account, and to keep it secure.
To connect you with providers, and so a provider knows where and when to carry out the service you booked.
To verify providers' identity, which is what makes the platform usable between strangers.
To email you about things that happened in your account — a booking, an invitation, a confirmation. We do not send advertising.
To detect and stop abuse.

sections.heading: Who it is shared with
body: With the other party to a booking, and only as far as the booking needs: a provider sees your name, contact and the service address; a customer sees the provider's name and contact.
With suppliers that run the platform: Resend sends our email, Cloudflare hosts the application, Neon hosts the database. They process the data on our behalf and may not use it for anything else.
Where the law requires it.
We do not sell your data, and we do not hand it to anyone who wants it for advertising.

sections.heading: For how long
body: For as long as you have an account. If you delete it we delete your personal data, with two exceptions that exist for practical reasons: booking and payment records the law requires us to keep, and email addresses that have permanently bounced, which we keep on a list precisely so we never write to them again.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: You can see and correct most of your data in your account, at any time.
You can ask for a copy of your data, or ask us to delete it, by writing to privacidade@ntizo.co.mz. We answer within 30 days.
If you signed in with Google you can withdraw that access in your Google account settings. That does not delete your Ntizo account — for that, ask us.

sections.heading: Security
body: Passwords are stored hashed. Traffic between you and the platform is encrypted. Providers' identity documents have no public address: they are reachable only through an authenticated request by an administrator.
No system is proof against everything. If there is ever a breach that affects you, we will tell you.

sections.heading: Changes
body: If we change this document materially we will email you before the change takes effect. The date at the top always says when it was last revised.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Ntizo. Creating an account accepts them. If you disagree with something here, do not use the platform — and tell us why, which is useful information.

sections.heading: What Ntizo is, and is not
body: Ntizo is a marketplace connecting people looking for a service with people who provide one. We do not provide the services listed: the provider you booked does, and the contract for the service is with them.
We verify providers' identity before letting them list. That is not a guarantee of the quality of the work — it is a guarantee that we know who they are.

sections.heading: Your account
body: You must be at least 18.
The details you give must be true, and kept current. A wrong address costs somebody a journey.
You are responsible for what happens in your account. Keep your password safe and tell us if you think somebody reached it.
One person, one account.

sections.heading: Bookings, prices and the service fee
body: The price of a service is set by the provider and shown before you confirm.

A platform service fee applies to every booking, as a percentage of the price the provider set. The fee is deducted from what the provider is paid — it is not added to what you, the customer, pay: the price shown to you is the price you pay. The percentage is set per provider and shown to them before they list a service.
Cancellations follow the conditions shown at the time of booking.

sections.heading: If you are a provider
body: List only services you can actually carry out, and describe them honestly.
Honour the bookings you accept, or cancel early enough for the customer to make other arrangements.
You are responsible for the licences, insurance and tax obligations your activity requires. We are not your employer.
Documents you upload for verification are used for that and nothing else.

sections.heading: What is not allowed
body: Using the platform for anything unlawful, or listing services Mozambican law does not permit.
Impersonating someone, or listing on behalf of somebody who did not authorise it.
Harassing, threatening or discriminating against another user.
Arranging outside the platform to avoid the service fee, once contact was made through it.
Attempting to reach accounts or data that are not yours.

sections.heading: Reviews
body: Reviews belong to whoever writes them and must describe a real experience. We do not remove them for being negative. We do remove ones that are false, abusive, or written by somebody who never had the service.

sections.heading: Liability
body: We do what we can to keep the platform available and correct, but we do not warrant it free of errors or interruptions.

We are not answerable for the performance of the service itself, which is the provider's responsibility. We help resolve disputes and can suspend accounts, but the work is contracted between the two parties.
Nothing in these terms removes rights the law gives you that cannot be removed.

sections.heading: Suspension and closure
body: You can delete your account whenever you want.
We can suspend or close an account that breaks these terms, and we explain why unless doing so would compromise an investigation or somebody's safety.

sections.heading: Governing law
body: These terms are governed by the law of the Republic of Mozambique, and the Mozambican courts have jurisdiction over disputes arising from them.

sections.heading: Changes
body: We may revise these terms. If a change is material we will email you before it takes effect. Continuing to use the platform after that means you accept them.
